content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICMR Young Professional-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Young Professional-II position at ICMR is scheduled for 22 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: To be eligible, candidates must have a Post Graduate degree in Biostatistics, Statistics, Demography, Population Studies, Public Health, or Medical Sociology with a minimum of 55% marks.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any post-qualification experience required for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need to have at least 1 year of post-qualification experience in a relevant field to be considered for the Young Professional-II position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Young Professional-II post is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Young Professional-II position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 42,000.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the ICMR Young Professional-II recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in recruitment. Eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview directly at the specified venue on the given date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Young Professional-II position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in New Delhi. The exact venue details can be found in the official notification.
